tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal ba sras brgyad bstod 'phrin dge legs kun 'byung bzhugs// mi mjed 'jig rten ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /mkhyen brtse'i stobs ldan zla zhun bdud rtsi'i thigs/ /rtsod dus 'gro ba'i snying la 'phos pa'i bcud/ /zas gtsang sras kyis deng 'dir bde legs stsol/ /mkhyen pa'i ral gris srid pa'i 'khri shing bcad/ /phan bde'i lo 'bras me tog dar babs pa/ /mi shes mun sel thugs rje'i 'od snang gis/ /thar pa'i lam ston zur phud lnga par bstod/ /mthu stobs rdo rjes bdud kyi snying 'byin yang / /brtse chen bdud rtsis bde ba'i srog 'tsho ba/ /dpa' bas tshar gcod thugs rjes rjes 'dzin mkhan/ /thugs kyi rdo rje drag shul che de bstod/ /skye 'gro'i sdug bsngal dkar min rdul gyi tshogs/ /spyan 'bras chu klung rab dkar rgyun gyis bkrus/ /phyag stong 'gro la 'khyud pa'i grib bsil gyis/ /'gro tshogs skyob mdzad phyag na padmar bstod/ /legs byas pad dkar 'dab stong mi zum zhing / /gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i mtha' la mi rgyu yang / /khyod zhal ri bong can gyi 'dzum mdangs kyis/ /bdag yid 'phrog byed sa yi snying por bstod/ /gang sku ma la ya rlung dri ldan gyis/ /gnyis 'dzin sprin tshogs sangs pas gnyis med kyi/ /ye shes gnam sngon 'od du zhu ba bzhin/ /sgrib pa rnam sel rgyal ba'i sras por bstod/ /gzhan snang me tog spos dang rgyal mtshan gdugs/ /phyi nang mchod sprin nor 'dzin kun khyab la/ /khrel bzhin gsang ba bde chen mchod pa'i tshogs/ /mkha' khyab sprul mkhas nam mkha'i snying por bstod/ /byams pa'i snying stobs gnyis 'thung 'khor ba yi/ /sdug bsngal sme sngags tsha zer gyis gdung bas/ /snying rje rgya mtshor zhugs 'dis gzhan dag gi /'khrul pa 'gog byed rgyal tshab byams par bstod/ /kun bzang mchod sprin nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /'dod yon phang phung sa steng khyab pa der/

/ngom pa bzhin du ngo mtshar 'dzum byed pa/ /kun bzang rgyal ba'i mchod sprin mkhan la bstod/ /kun nas dga' ba'i rnam dpyod lcags kyu yis/ /sras bcas rgyal ba mdun du spyan drangs te/ /dad pas mchod sprin dpag yas kyis mchod tshe/ /bkra shis snyan par sgrog 'di ngo mtshar gnas/ /dad dang dpyod ldan kun nas dga' ba'i mtshan/ /bkra shis dge mtshan ldan pa'i sbyin bdag tsho'i/ /bsod nams mthu las gsar du 'khrungs pa bzhin/ /rgyal ba sras bcas mdun du mngon sum byon/ /e ma ngo mtshar rmad byung dge legs 'dis/ /yab yum sras bcas tshe ring bdud las rgyal/ /bsam don yid bzhin gzhan gyis sdud byed pa'i/ /phun tshogs nam mkha'i mthar thug gnas gyur cig /bzo rig bal po a mi rā dza zhes/ /bi shwa karma'i rnam 'phrul rig pa can/ /blta bas mi ngom 'gran zla kun bral 'di/ /kun dga' bsod nams las yin gzhan gyis min/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i ngo mtshar mchod sprin 'di/ /shākya'i rgyal po thugs sras brgyad kyis bskor/ /bstan srung dregs byed mchod 'os 'dzum zhal du/ /mchod pa 'bul lo 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol/ /rnam thos sras dang arya dzambha lha/ /yid bzhin nor bu mgon po tshe dpag med/ /gur mgon gdong bzhi phyag drug las mkhan bcas/ /tshe sogs 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog /ces sogs shākya'i dge slong nā gardzu nas thol byung du smras pa'o/ /yi ge'i 'du byed mkhas pa rdzong ri pas/ /ri mor bris 'di slar yang brkos byed mkhan/ /rdzong ri byams rgyan bdag gis gzab ste brkos/ /mtshan ldan bla ma dges pa'i bkra shis shog /shubhaṃ/ mi dbang kun dga'i mtshan can gyis bskul nas so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ rgyal ba sras brgyad bstod 'phrin/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
